description: Actualizaciones de viaje GTFS_Realtime is a dataset listed in Dades Obertes FGC open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat de Catalunya (FGC). Proporciona información sobre las actualizaciones de viaje siguiendo la especificación de GTFS Realtime - Trip updates. El GTFS Realtime complementa el formato GTFS de horarios estáticos de transporte público. Coverage: Catalonia (Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat de Catalunya network). The portal files it under Servicios a los viajeros, Turismo. Its keywords are gtfs realtime, trip updates, viajes, retrasos, cancelaciones, cambios. The portal shows 1 records. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution License 4.0 (cc-by 4.0) (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-dadesobertes-fgc-cat-portal.
